decision: Preserve assay, route, cargo, pooling, formulation role, and study identity. Never pool all lung values into one scalar target.

ready_now.explanation: 1,975 LNPDB lung rows + 1,920 LUMI rows + 444 LuT rows. This is a measurement-row count, not a count of mutually unique lipids and not a single exchangeable response table.

sources.deduplication_rule: Canonical source anchor. Rows copied into LiON or recovered from the original RCB/CAD papers join to this record and do not become new observations.

sources.in_vivo_boundary: Only six leading LUMI lipids were advanced to intratracheal in-vivo testing; the 1,920 labels are human-bronchial-epithelial in-vitro measurements.
sources.deduplication_rule: Join by canonical full SMILES against LNPDB/LiON. Preserve the LUMI assay as an independent measurement even when chemistry overlaps.

sources.formulation_role_boundary: The varied LuT molecule is a quaternary cationic lung-targeting component used together with the fixed ionizable lipid 4A3-SC7. It is not interchangeable with a conventional four-component ionizable-lipid label.
sources.structure_blocker: Official Fig. 2/3 workbooks expose compound IDs, head/tail identities, expression, and selectivity but not full product SMILES. Until building-block structures are reconstructed and chemically validated, LuT uses component/SAR features and cannot enter Morgan or graph-representation cells.
sources.deduplication_rule: Compound key is round + head + tail. DOTAP controls are excluded. Full-structure cross-source overlap remains unknown until the product structures are reconstructed.

Treat LiON as a released preprocessing/modeling view over source studies. The 8,518 canonical overlaps join LNPDB; only non-overlapping chemistry or measurements with distinct provenance can add rows.

sources.trainable_boundary: Broad A549 screening plus tiered/pooled pulmonary evaluation; only the released individual intratracheal functional rows are treated as individual in-vivo labels.
sources.deduplication_rule: The LNPDB A549 and 49 intratracheal rows are the canonical copies. Do not append the paper tables again.

sources.trainable_boundary: The 96 systemic IV labels are barcode uptake/biodistribution, not functional expression. Individual functional validation exists only for a small lead set.
sources.deduplication_rule: Use the LNPDB 96-row LX_2024 task as the canonical copy.

sources.trainable_boundary: TNS/physicochemical labels cover the library; only 49 candidates were individually tested for in-vivo expression. Helper-lipid-dependent lung cell specificity must remain formulation context.
sources.deduplication_rule: Freeze the supplementary row table and canonicalize before admitting it; headline 580 is not counted as 580 lung-expression labels.

sources.trainable_boundary: Functional Cre delivery was assayed across 14 cell types, but the paper reports no detected lung or kidney delivery. Use as formulation/cell-type negative supervision, not as 65 positive lung chemotypes.
Broad library evidence is primarily in vitro; U155 is the main in-vivo pulmonary lead. Do not relabel 155 rows as in-vivo lung potency.
Individual IV organ expression/selectivity is usable after freezing Table S4; the earlier 1,500-lipid screen was intramuscular and is not a lung dataset.

global_deduplication_keys.measurement: publication_id + experiment_id + source_row + route + cargo + dose + timepoint + tissue_or_cell + readout_type + replicate_or_pool_id
global_deduplication_keys.split_group: publication/study + chemical family + linker/head/tail family; duplicated compilations inherit the original study group
